result.overallRead: The resume communicates relevant product-marketing experience but reads junior for a mid-level (2–6 yr) candidate because almost every role-line is duty-focused and lacks measurable outcomes. Sections expected at this stage are present, but bullets need stronger action verbs and quantified impact; tightening those will materially improve interview chances. Next step: pick a target role and replace duty statements with outcome-framed bullets that include concrete metrics.

dimensionNotes.note: All expected sections (Contact, Experience, Education, Skills) are present.
Most bullets are duty statements with no outcome metrics; for a mid-level candidate this is the primary barrier to appearing senior.
Extracted text appears clean with no interleaved columns, pseudo-tables, or unusual glyphs that would break ATS parsing.
Many bullets start with weak/passive openers (Responsible for, Worked on, Helped, Involved, Assisted); stronger leading verbs would improve skim/read.
Recent role has reasonable bullet count but lacks depth; overall resume is short and should reallocate space to quantified, high-impact accomplishments.

findings.originalText: Responsible for product launch communications across the EMEA region.
findings.suggestedText: Led product launch communications across the EMEA region, resulting in [X% increase in awareness] and generating [Y] qualified leads.
findings.reason: A duty statement; hiring managers need the measurable outcome of your communications work to judge scope and impact.

findings.originalText: Worked on positioning and messaging for two product lines.
findings.suggestedText: Owned positioning and messaging for two product lines, improving win rate by [X%] in target accounts and shortening sales cycle by [Y] days.
findings.reason: Doesn't state ownership or outcomes; quantify how messaging changed buyer behavior or sales results.

findings.originalText: Helped with sales enablement materials and competitive briefs.
findings.suggestedText: Created sales enablement materials and competitive briefs that enabled sellers to close [X%] more deals in competitive situations and reduced ramp time by [Y] weeks.
findings.reason: ‘Helped with’ is a duty and lacks impact; buyers need evidence of effectiveness and ownership.

findings.suggestedText: Designed and conducted customer research interviews that informed [X] product decisions and increased feature adoption by [Y%].
findings.reason: Vague participation claim; quantify findings and the product or business changes they enabled.

findings.originalText: Assisted the demand generation team with campaign copy.
findings.suggestedText: Wrote campaign copy for demand generation that improved click-through rate by [X%] and contributed to [Y] MQLs.
findings.reason: ‘Assisted’ and no metric; tie copy work to concrete campaign performance.

findings.originalText: Supported the marketing team with content production.
findings.suggestedText: Produced content (blog, whitepapers) that drove [X%] more organic traffic and contributed to [Y] leads per month.
findings.reason: Generic support statement; quantify reach and lead generation impact of content work.

findings.originalText: Managed the company blog and social media calendar.
findings.suggestedText: Managed company blog and social calendar, increasing blog sessions by [X%] and social engagement by [Y%].
findings.reason: Management duties need outcome metrics showing audience growth or engagement.

findings.originalText: Helped organise webinars and trade show presence.
findings.suggestedText: Organised webinars and trade show presence that generated [X] leads and supported [Y] sales opportunities.
findings.reason: ‘Helped organise’ is vague; tie event work to lead/sales outcomes and your role in driving them.
The resume is short and under-leverages the candidate's 4 years; expand Experience with 1–2 quantified achievements per role instead of duties to signal scope.

signals: 62 full-time month(s) (~5.2 years) across 2 role(s), excluding 0 internship(s).
Domains are consistent: all roles listed are in product marketing/marketing within the software/B2B domain; no switch to a different domain is evident.
Region could not be inferred from contact, education, or role location.
